subject: session, chunk: refactor re-used chunk allocator in executor (#49667)
summary: Reviewed aeefec893d4b2b9550560a0011c778a953f54e16 relative to parent. Change refactors chunk allocator plumbing: SessionVars now provides a non-nil allocator (empty allocator when disabled), wraps the per-connection allocator with synchronization + a reuse hook to set StmtCtx.useChunkAlloc, and updates executors to allocate via AllocPool.Alloc directly. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in executor/sessionctx correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session behavior, or concurrency for the touched paths.
